pins.name: LunarTune
pins.text: LunarTune is a modern, privacy-respecting YouTube Music streaming client built from the ground up for Android using Jetpack Compose and Material 3 design guidelines. It brings ad-free listening, lossless audio fallback, rich synced lyrics, and unmatched visual customization right into your hands.

pins.name: OrionStore
pins.text: A high-performance repository explorer and Android application distribution platform designed with a modern Neobrutalist aesthetic. Built with React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, and Node.js.

pins.name: Koda.web
pins.text: A Material 3 Expressive Music and Video app for Android with YT Music Support

pins.name: Portfolio
pins.text: Ordinary coder & gamer boy. A personal portfolio and creative engineering showcase built with React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, GSAP, Motion, Matter.js, and OGL (WebGL).

pins.name: VibeViz
pins.text: VibeViz is a high-performance web application built with React, TypeScript, MediaPipe Tasks Vision, and Tailwind CSS. It provides real-time multi-perspective analytics including 52-point facial blendshape emotion tracking and 21-point dual-hand gesture / sign language recognition.
